//overrides: Next 15.5.22 is the latest 15.x and still pins postcss 8.4.31 and sharp ^0.34.3.
Both carry published advisories on the production dependency path:
postcss <=8.5.22  path traversal + XSS, x4      GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 et al
npm's suggested fix is next@16 -- a major upgrade. These pin the exact versions
Next 16.3.0 itself moved to, clearing the advisories without the breaking change.
sharp is overridden tree-wide rather than only under `next`, because wrangler
pulls its own older copy (0.33.5) as well.
NOTE: npm will not re-evaluate overrides against an existing node_modules tree.
If these ever appear not to apply, `rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json` first.
Remove this block when the project moves to Next 16.
